purpose: Original non-scaling/effect-context screen: exact sources/options and independent native pixels, with both source roles individually discovered.
sourceGeneration: SvgShaderContextReferenceTests.CreateSource reproduces the authored original matrix; no SVG/PNG collection is added.

nativeCapture.recipe: Original Image.decode from a Blob URL, then canvas.drawImage at ceil(32*outputScale) square pixels. Empty CSS, no fonts/resources, transparent background, device scale 1. Original scripts are evaluated unchanged in 54 ordered 120-pair chunks.

referencePolicy: Complete canonical straight RGBA8 SHA256 plus width/height preserves exact comparison; zero-alpha RGB follows the existing PixelComparer contract. Original native PNG identities remain, and both roles keep separate source identities and test invocations. Sharing a measured equal image does not remove a case.
